props.name: type
props.description: "single" allows one pressed item at most, "multiple" allows any number.

props.name: value
props.description: Pressed values. Set it to control the component.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Pressed values at the start when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new list of pressed values.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required: names the group for screen readers.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer element.
